comments.author: @NT4XT
comments.text: If i win MegaMillion lotto, I'd buy dual citizenship and possibly exit my body someday decades away, sonewhere in Finland.  Where it's cold and forested, under the Aurora Borealis ☺️  In a modest, well designed home, heated with well designed wood stoves, ½ under ground, but with excellent, controlled ventilation.  Oh, and two kinds of backup electric power, utilizing ONLY, incandescent full spectrum light bulbs.  And where there's plentiful fishing within 50 yards.  Small greenhouse with Full Spectrum UV lamps, for growing tomatoes, peppers, potatoes, lettuce, and in the basement, mushrooms.  I'll simply buy white rice from where ever.  As well as whatever Fins imbibe, in moderation.  Beef and chicken via the grocery store an hour away by truck - or 4WD hatchback (like a 2016 Ford Focus RS).  lol. A lovely dream.  I suppose the same might be available in Alaska, no need for Naturalization.  But Finnish ness would be completely missing.
